jobs.description: Back to Careers Position Research Engineer - Device Physics R&D Tel Aviv Full-time What will you do? Vectorious has developed the world’s first in-heart microcomputer and is on a mission to transform heart failure treatment. Testing and characterization: Planning experiments, writing test codes, using standard testing equipment and dedicated test equipment, performing experiments, analyzing data and drawing conclusions and recommendations Data Analysis: Collect, process and analysis of raw data from our MEMS devices, implants and other inputs, including data from various points in the production process and field deployments Modeling: Build empirical and theoretical models based on experimental data and physical models, device physics research, interface with Algo team for drift mitigation based on those models. Develop deep understanding of Vectorious’ Left Atrium Pressure measurement system, based on those models and recommend system improvements Heat transfer Perform thermal FEA and analytical models to the system (implant and external electronic unit) and conduct experiments to verify those analytical and numerical models Failure Analysis, reliability and burn in: Investigate and diagnose any anomalies or failures in the ASICs, MEMS devices and systems (implant and external electronic unit) by running tests, analyzing data, identifying root causes, and proposing corrective actions.
